(ta)༄༅/ /dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/tsa turmu kha sa ma ya sid

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tsa turmu kha sa ma ya sid+dhi sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ zhal bzhi pa'i dam tshig gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang ni yi dam lha// zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas la 'dud// rtsa zhal nag po ro za ba// g.yas zhal dkar po khro zhing 'dzum// g.yon pa dmar zhing rgya cher bzhad// steng zhal nag po khro zhal ni// bdud dang srin po lha srin dang*// gshin rje la sogs skrag par mdzad// drag rgyas dbang dang zhi ba ni// zhal bzhi'i kha dog dag gis shes// de dag bla ma'i zhal shes ni// las bzhi bsgrub par 'dod pa yis// phug dang nags dang dur khrod dang*// dmar zhing mtho ba me tog brgyan// dben zhing nyams dga' sgrub pa'i gnas// der 'dug spros pa bcad par bya// shog gu gro ga dur khrod ras// dung dang gur gum sin+dhū ra// dur khrod sol bas snag tsha'o// rtsa ba dang ni sham bu'i sngags// bton dang bcug pa man ngag yin// bsnyen te sgrub pa las la sbyar// dung dang ra gan zangs dang lcags// maṇ+ḍal snod kyi bye brag go /lha dang 'khor lo 'od zer yang*// bsgom pa'i rim pa shes par bya// snga dro dus dang nyi ma'i zer// zla ba yar ngo mar ngo yi// de dag dus kyang shes par bya// phreng ba gos dang rgyan rnams shes// mar dang sbrang rtsi bu ram dang*// zho dang 'bru dang rin chen lnga// dug yungs khrag sogs dbye ba shes// ma rungs zhi dang mngon spyod rgyas// sgrub dang dbang sdud tshar gcod pa// bsam pa'i bye brag shes par bya// rang dang bsgrub bya'i bsod nams brtag /sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid de yis shes// bstan pa'i don spyad the tshom med// rgyal khams dang ni grong khyer gcig /dbye ba'i rim pas shes par bya// las mtha' sdud pa man ngag yin// zhal gyi u pa de sha 'di// rak+ṣi ta yis mdzad pa las// gnyan lo dar ma grags kyis bsgyur// bla ma yi dam chos skyong la// nyes pa gang snang bzod par gsol// //
༈ /dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rtsa ba ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mchan bshad du grags pa bzhugs so// shrī ma hā kā la pū dzi ti/

dpal nag po chen po mchod na/ nir ma phu lan tsa/ me tog rnying pa/ ma hā māṃ sa dhūp+pa/ sha chen gyi dud pa btang*/ dho si maṇ+ḍa la/ rdo yi dkyil 'khor byas la/ e ka man+t+ra la/ sngags gcig gis/ yak+ṣa nī da srī la byin/ gnod sbyin mo dang*/ dpal ldan ma/ bha ling bhan+dha/ de wī ka ra ye/ yum gyi gtor ma gnyis bya zer ba bla dpe la snang zer yang ma bzhi'o/ yak+ṣi nī bha liṃ mi taṃ/ gnod sbyin pho mo gnyis kyi gtor ma nub mo bsngos/ shrī he ka ra tri tha pa ye ta/ dpal ldan ma mtshan mo/ a kā ro ma da na bhan+dha sā tā ta bya/ chang gi snod drag tu dbul/ a bha wa be sa da tha ba ya ta/ yum gyi gtogs pa nub mo dbul/ pu rak+ṣo pa man+t+ra dang*/ grong khyer bskyod pa'i sngags/ sā dha nā ma dang*/ bsgrub bya'i ming bri/ 'di u tsa ra naṃ ka ta bya/ brjod par bya ba gang zhe na/ sa i yaṃ/ sa i yaṃ la sogs pa lnga'o// ka ra la hi yaṃ/ ba hu baṃ/ ghṛ ta kī li kī lā ya/ bi bhi sha nā pa ta na mo/ sngags 'di gsum an ta mu shar bcug la/ pus mo nub tsam gyi chu nang du sba'o// ki tsu bi si/ gnod pa chung du bstan pa/ sha ka ra du mid tsa pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i lam du an ta/ la sbal/ mu shar bcug la sba'o// yar ngo'i brgyad dang*/ mar ngo'i brgyad la bha liṃ ta dang*/ sngags 'di tshar gsum mam gcig bzlas nas/ gtor ma gong ma gtsang sar dor/ 'og ma bzhag la nang par btang*/ dus gcig tu byin gyis brlab/ dus gcig tu bsngo'o// rten gyi mdun du bya ba'i las la/ tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi la me tog rnying pa dang*/ tshil chen gyi dud pa btang*/ lha bshos khrag gis byugs/ tshil chen mar me bya/ dri mi zhim pa dang*/ sran ma la sogs pa'i gtor ma gnyis byas la/ yab la sngags gong mas nub mo dbul/ yum la sngags 'og mas nub mo byin la nang par btang ngo*// //

༈ /zhing skyong chen po tsa turmu kha'i rjes gnang bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha sidhā ya/ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa yi// thugs las sprul pa'i ye shes pa// gnyen mgon zhal bzhi 'khor bcas kyi// rjes gnang cho ga bshad kyis nyon// de la 'dir dpal mgon gyi rjes su gnang ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po 'di'i bsnyen pa dang rjes su gnang ba thob pas gnas dben par tshes brgyad la sogs pa dus khyad par can la mdun gyi stegs ji ltar rigs pa la rdo nag gi mal la nas nag gi tshom bu lnga bkod la/ de'i mdun tu gtor ma 'jig rten las 'das pa gur gyi gtor ma/ 'di'i skong gtor dang*/ las mgon dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga tshan pa gnyis dang*/ lha bshos gru gsum khrag gis byugs pa lnga dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod nas nag sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams la/ slob dpon gyis gsang ba 'dus pa'i bdag bskyed dam/ yang na kye rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa gtor ma 'bul ba dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas yi dam dang*/ mgon po lcam dral la gtor 'bul grub mtshams dpal mgon gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng zhes pa nas mdun bskyed spyan 'dren/ gtor 'bul/ skong gso bcas dang*/ las mgon dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ mdun bzlas/ bshags pa/ bstod pa/ rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam bar mthong brgyud ltar bya ba ni slob dpon gyis bya ba'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'am/ kye rdor gang rung gi dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma bdun nam dgu la sogs pa khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu sogs grub nas slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba dang*/

gnas skabs su dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i ched du dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhing skyong tsa turmu kha'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang*// zhes gsungs pas snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir chos spyod pa'i gang zag nyung zhing re re tsam byung ba'ang bar chad kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'byung bas de nyid zlog pa'i thabs la srung ma khyad par can re bsten dgos/ de la 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis las/ 'jig rten pa'i srung ma rnams ni bsten kyang dgos pa chung ba yin te/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen pos/ rang nyid 'khor ba'i brtson rwar 'chings pa yi// 'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyob par nus// zhes gsungs pas chos byed pa'i gang zag rnams kyis 'jig rten pa'i srung ma rnams la snying rjes gtor ma re tsam ster ba ma gtogs bsten cing bsgrub par bya ba ma yin no// des na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa re bsten dgos pas/ de la rgyud sde so so nas gsungs pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang nas 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa mchog tu gyur pa zab pa las kyang ches zab cing gnyen pa ni/ rdo rje nag po chen po gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa 'di nyid yin te/ de'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ thog mar yid ches shing khungs btsun par byed pa'i phyir lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na sngon gyi dus su bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba chen po de nyid kyis rgya gar du chos slob tu byon nas bla ma san+dhe pa chen po rat+na kīrti dang rdo rje gdan pa sogs las chos mang du gsan/

rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par mkhyen nas bod la log 'byon khar bla ma san+dhe pa las gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang zhus pas ngas mi 'ong*/ kha sar+pā ṇa'i lho phyogs kyi ri sul gyi nags gseb cig na nga yi mched mo rnal 'byor ma ku sā li pa bya ba zhig gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa mdzad cing yod pas der song la zhus shig khyed dang las kyi 'brel ba yod pas dbang dang gdams ngag gnang bar 'dug gi gsungs/ kha sar+pā ṇi'i lho phyogs zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go chas ri bo po ta la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kha sar+pā ṇi dngos su spyan drangs nas de wī ko ṭa na bzhugs shing*/ de'i lho phyogs kyi ri sul na yod pas de skad bya ba yin no// gong ltar bla ma san+dhe pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad nas gnyan los byon pas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin ri sul gyi nags gseb na shing sdong po chen po zhig gi khog pa na rnal 'byor ma dpon g.yog bzhi gda' skad/ de'i nang nas g.yog mo gsum ras mos kyis grong 'dabs na phar phyin te 'tsho ba btsal nas sgrub pa mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ lo tsā bas bla mas lung bstan pa'i rnal 'byor ma yin min brtag pa'i phyir g.yog mo rnams rnal 'byor ma yin na nus pa cig ston dang gsungs pas/ gcig gis brang gshags nas khog pa'i nang nas bla ma gsang 'dus kyi lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mar me bstan pas nges shes skyes nas gtso mo la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul te gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur zhus pas khyod la sus lung bstan gsung*/ nga la bla ma san+dhe pas lung bstan zhus pas/ ngas 'jam pa'i rdo rje las gnang ba ma thob pas khyod rang sdod khom na lo gcig nas dbang bskur bya gsung*/ de bzhin bgyi zhus pas/ 'o na khyod la mtha' 'khob kyi mi ngan dang*/ gcan gzan dang*/ dug sbrul la sogs pa'i 'tshe ba 'byung dogs yod pas grong 'dabs pha ki na bram ze mdog sngo ba mi rkang gi gling bu thogs pa gcig yod pas de dang 'grogs la ci za ci 'thung gi phud nas byin/

ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur gyis shig ngas bar chad mi 'byung bar byin gyis brlab gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas lo gcig song nas da ngas lha la gnang ba thob pas dbang bya yis/ tshogs kyi yo byad tshol cig gsungs nas gser zho gsum la zho gang la 'bras khal bcu gsum blangs nas chang byas/ zho gang la sha dang*/ zho gang la spos la sogs pa gzhan dgos pa'i yo byad rnams bsgrubs nas khyer te/ rnal 'byor ma'i drung du phyin nas tshogs rdzas rnams phul/ gdan mang po bshams tshar ba dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i zhal nas mgron spyan drongs shig gsung ba la bdag gis mi rnyed zhus pas/ 'o na khar seng gi grogs po bram ze de bos gsungs nas/ bram ze bos pas des skra gseb nas mi rkang gi gling bu phyung ste bus ma thag phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor pho mo rgyan cha lugs mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/ zhing skyong bka' sdod bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus nas gral la 'khod cing*/ tshogs kyis tshim par byas pas mnyes te dbang yongs su rdzogs par gnang*/ de nas gdams pa rgya mtsho ltar gsan cing*/ spyir thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa/ thugs dam du gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ uṣ+ṇī ṣa/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ chos skyong gi gdams pa dang lnga gnang ngo*// khyad par du chos skyong 'di dngos su gnang ste/ dbang gi dus su bram ze de la khyod kyis 'di'i g.yog gyis/ 'gal rkyen spongs la mthun rkyen sgrubs shig ces bka' bsgos nas mi la mi ngo sprod pa bzhin du dngos su gnang ba ni chos skyong yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu 'di yin pas byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pas sgrub thag nye ba'i gdams pa shin tu thugs rtsis che ba yin no// de nas bla ma gnyan lo tsā bas rgya gar nas bod la 'byon dus bal yul phan chad du dngos su 'grogs pa la/ bod kyi sne zin nas dngos su ma byung*/

dgos skabs che dus dngos su yong zhes grags/ bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba chen po kha che khri stan nas pu hrang byas byon pas mnga' bdag rtse lde'i bsam pa la nga rgyal po yin/ mnga' ris stod na nga las grags che ba dang dbang stobs che ba med pas lo tsā ba nga la mjal du yongs nas phyag 'tshal snyam pa la/ bla ma gnyan gyi thugs dgongs la/ nga rgya gar gyi paṇa grub rnams kyi slob ma lo tsā ba chen po yin/ khyad par du rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ bla ma san+dhe pa rin chen grags pa/ mar me mdzad bzang po rnams kyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa yin pas btsad pos nga la phyag dang sna len sogs byed dam snyam nas bla ma tshong pa mang po dang 'grogs nas byon dus mnga' bdag la rgya gar nas phra ma byung ste/ gnyan lo zer ba 'dis rgya gar gyi ngan sngags thams cad bslabs nas song bas der gsha' ma mi byed zer ba dang*/ rgyal po yang ngan chags che bas 'khrul nas bden snyam/ blon po dpa' rtsal dang ldan pa'i rta pa sum cu bla ma bkrongs du btang bas/ bla ma'i mnal lam du rgyal pos brdzangs pa'i blon po gdug pa can rnams mkhyen te tshong pa rnams la phye phud sdus shig nged rang tsho la bar chad cig yong bar 'dug pas chos skyong rnams la gtor ma chen po btang dgos par 'dug gsungs nas/ gtor ma'i rgyu la spos 'bru sman sogs btab nas phul/ zhing skyong chen po tsa turmu kha 'di la gsol ba btab cing sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis tshong pa rnams kyi mthong snang la mon pa sngon po lnga gar byed pa/ bro byed pa gnyis/ gri skor byed pa gnyis/ jo mo zhwa thebs can gcig 'khor bka' skyong mang po byung ba mthong skad/ de nas rlung nag 'tshubs mar song nas mtha' bskor/ bla ma dpon slob dbus su bcug nas byon pas/ blon po rnams kyi mthong snang la rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i gseb nas a tsa ra gri skor byed pa gnyis min pa gzhan ci yang ma mthong zhing*/ phyir log nas yong bas bla ma dpon slob rnams phebs grub 'dug pa dang lo rgyus rnams rgyal po la zhib par zhus pas mnga' bdag rgyal po'i bsam pa la/

bla ma 'di chos skyong bran du khol nus pa zhig 'dug snyam pas slar 'gyod pa skyes nas bshags pa phul/ zhabs spyi bor blangs pas rgyal po rang ma grongs tsam byung yang*/ blon po la la kha nas khrag skyugs nas shi/ la la brgyal/ la la smyo/ la la rengs/ la la 'bogs te thams cad shi bas chos skyong gi nus mthu yin par grags so// de nas rim gyis byon te dpal sa skya'i phu gnam kha'u skyed lhas su phebs/ mgon po bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas phyag nas mdzad/ chos skyong 'di la bka' gtad mdzad dus gtsug lag khang la me 'bar bas me 'bar gyi gtsug lag khang zhes grags so// gnyan lo tsā ba chen pos bla ma gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan la chos skyong 'di'i rjes gnang sogs gdams pa rdzogs par gnang*/ 'di'i las tshogs la brten nas kha'u'i mdun ri la bon po'i grong mang du yod pa dang 'gras pa la/ lo gcig gi nang du bon po pho mo brgya tsam shi nas grong khyer brlag par mdzad pa ni chos skyong 'di'i nus mthu'i sgo nas yin pas nus mthu myur zhing tsha bar grags so// de nas dus re zhig lon pa na bla ma gnyan lo sku mya ngan las 'da' khar chos skyong gi rnam 'phrul ban chung de la nga mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dug pas kha'u brag rdzong na nged kyi bu'i mchog gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba yod pas/ de'i drung du song la nga la ji ltar byed pa bzhin khong gi g.yog tshul bzhin du gyis la khong mya ngan las 'das pa dang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du gshegs shig ces bka' gnang ba dang bka' bzhin du gnam kha'u ru byon nas bla ma gnam gyi nye gnas mdzad do// de nas dus re zhig lon pa na zhing skyong chen po 'di nyid bod kha ba can 'dir bstan pa bsrung bar bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel gyis nyin gcig kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa cig dang bstun/ gsol chu 'chu ba'i skyogs ri 'gram gyi chu khar lus pa kha'u'i brag rdzong gi rtse'i sgrub khang gi skar seng nas phyag ring brkyangs nas bzhes pa bla ma gnam gyis gzigs pas khyed mi gzhan pas rtsal che zhing rdzu 'phrul du ma ston pa cig 'dug pa dang*/

khyad par da lan rdzu 'phrul gyis skyogs len lugs de bzhin ngo mtshar che bas sprul pa yin nges su 'dug pas sku dngos su ston pa cig 'tshal zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma de skad mi gsung ba zhu/ nged rang gnyis ka la mi legs gsungs pa la/ slar yang gsol ba btab pas nga dam tshig bsrung du chug sngon ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma'i bka' bzhin gnyan gyi chag phyi byas/ da yang gnyan gyi bka' bzhin khyed nam gshegs bar chag phyi byas mthar rgya gar la 'gror chug gsungs/ slar nan gyis gsol ba btab pas des na bla ma rang skrag pa'i snang ba cung zad tsam yang mdzad mi 'tshal gsungs nas zhal bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi sku nam mkha'i khams khyab pa zhig sprul te bstan pas zil ches pas bla ma yang cung zad rtog med du gyur/ de las sangs te gzigs pas shangs mtshal cung zad kyang byung 'dug pa dang chos skyong gi sku sngar bzhin 'dug pas shangs mtshal gyis ras la sku de ji lta ba bzhin g.yas dkar g.yon dmar yod pa bris tshar ba dang*/ gzigs snang gi sku de nyid 'ja' 'od kyi rnam pas sgrub khang de'i brag skyibs la thim/ brag sgor deng sang gi bar du dngos su bzhugs zhes grags pa 'di yin no// bris sku de yang bla ma gnam gyi zhal gzigs mar grags pa da lta yang brag sgo rang na bzhugs so// de lta bu'i chos skyong gnyen zhing mthu rtsal dang ldan pa'i gdams pa zab mo rnams bla ma gnyan dang gnam kha'u pa gnyis ga las bla ma sa skya pa chen pos gsan pa'i zhing skyong chen po zhal bzhi pa'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ yi dam chos skyong gi bsnyen sgrub sogs song ba zhig dgos pa yin la/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma ni gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i dbang thob pa zhig la bya bar bshad la/ nam bya ba'i dus la/ khyad par gyi dus ni/ zla ba yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes brgyad gnyis dang*/

bcu bzhi dang*/ gnam stong ste de rnams gang rung rnams la bya dgos pa yin no// gang du bya ba'i gnas ni/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong ba nyer 'tshe med pa zhig tu bya dgos pa yin no// tshul ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyis mkha' 'gro chos skyong gtor mas mnyes par bya ba la/ dpal kye rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams bskyed la gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ skong gso mchod gtor bzlas pa bya ba rdo rje'i glu bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi bar ram/ tshogs 'khor yod na lhag gtor gyi bar du bya dgos pa grub zin nas/ gnyis pa khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la rjes su gnang ba'i sngon 'gro la/ slob dpon la kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis sogs nas/ bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes dang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// nas/ gnang bar mdzod// ces dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches bdag la rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas rgyun bshags bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal kye rdo rje'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang*/ 'og gi cha la ye shes kyi mgon po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag dang gzhan gyi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la zhes sogs nas/ 'grub par shog ces pa rnams sngon 'gro yin la/ dngos gzhi la gsum las/ thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la dpal kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa bskal pa'i me lta bu 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma shar ba lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pa khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ khyad par du rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po khams dang skye mched nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad bya sgro mes tshig pa ltar gzhob thul gyis bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur par mos/ de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes brjod pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du sangs kyis sbyangs par mos/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gnas pa'i sa phyogs su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du khyed rang rnams kyis sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag re rer gyur par mos nas/ de las 'od zer 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po zhes pa nas/ g.yas na bya nag gshog skor byed pa/ g.yon na khyi nag 'khang zhing zug pa/ rgyab na lce spyang 'bros 'ded byed pa/ mdun na mi nag gnam du 'o dod 'bod pa/

steng na rigs lnga'i khyung chen lding ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bar lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thob na mgon por bskyed/ ma thob na yi dam du bskyed gsungs pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dpal kye rdo rje zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de ltar khyed rang rnams dpal kye rdo rje'am rdo rje nag po chen po'i nga rgyal du gnas pa'i mdun du pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i zhes sogs nas/ bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon la kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa pho nya dang lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang mdun bskyed kyi nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas ma bzod de 'dar phri li li byed pa'i ngang nas rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gang nas dgra bgegs log 'dren gyi tshogs thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus te cha gnyis su byas te cha gcig khyed rang rnams kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar thim/ gcig khyed rang rnams kyi mdun du bskyed pa'i nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa'i spyi bor thim pas lus kyi bar du gcod pa'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad nas rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku'i ngo bor rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/

sngags ring bzla zhing rol mo drag tu bya zhing gu gul gyis bdug des rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la dpal kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa pho nya dang lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas ma bzod de 'dar phri li li byed pa'i ngang nas rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa rnams kyi gsung gi rang bzhin nam srog gi snying po thams cad sngags kyi phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gang nas dgra bgegs log 'dren gyi tshogs thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus te cha gnyis su byas te cha gcig khyed rang rnams kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar thim/ cha gcig khyed rang rnams kyi mdun du bskyed pa'i nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas pa'i mgrin par thim pas ngag gi bar du gcod pa'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad nas rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung gi ngo bor rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ sngags ring bzla ba sogs sngar bzhin no// slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la dpal kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa pho nya dang lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/

khyad par du yang khyed rang rnams kyi mdun du bskyed pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas ma bzod de 'dar phri li li byed pa'i ngang nas rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa rnams kyi gsung gi rang bzhin nam srog gi snying po thams cad sngags kyi phreng ba'i tshul du byung ste khyed rang rnams yi dam gyi lha'am mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas srog snying thams cad dbang du 'dus par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sngags ring thung gnyis lan gsum dang*/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos te slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ mgon po bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// de ltar me tog phul ba de dang maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus na me tog gi tshom bu blangs pa de nyid khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste/ mgon po 'di la sbyin lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad sogs lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngags kyi byin rlabs nus mthu ma lus pa rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig des rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung gi sogs 'gre'o// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer tshar zhing rtsub pa pho nya dang lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang mdun bskyed kyi nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas ma bzod de 'dar phri li li byed pa'i ngang nas rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo gri gug thod pa khrag gis gang ba ral gri rus pa'i phreng ba bum pa rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gang nas dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus pa cha gnyis su byas te cig khyed rang rnams kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar thim/

cha gcig khyed rang rnams kyi mdun du bskyed pa'i nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar thim pas sems kyi bar du gcod pa'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad nas rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kyi ngo bor rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ sngags ring bzla ba sogs dang*/ des sogs/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas mtha' rten gtor mas bka' bsgo ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis gtor ma slob ma'i lag g.yas su gtad de dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor ma'i steng du rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen mo sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa'i mtha' skor du bka' sdod zhing skyong sprul pa yang sprul dur khrod kyi bdag po dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas bzhugs par mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyi steng du 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar mos te rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgos pa ltar brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu bka' bsgos pas bka' bsgo zhal gyis bzhes par mos pa mdzod/ sngags ring gi rjes su/ sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/

dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ bla ma san+dhe pa chen po/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ yang na dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ na bza' brag phug pa chen po/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ yang na mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba/ yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ kha skong ni/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ zang chen sangs rgyas dpal ldan/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ byams pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ de dbon rin chen mchog grub/ thar rtse rdo rje 'chang byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang bla ma bdud kyi stobs 'phrog ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen la sogs pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzod cig 'di rnams chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig

steng gdon gza' dang drang srong gi gnod pa/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po dang*/ the'u rang gi gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig mthun pa'i rkyen tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa/ legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba mang po dbang du bsdus nas zas gos longs spyod kyis phongs pa med par yid bzhin du 'byor pa dang*/ de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs pa'i phrin las mdzod cig rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis mi thul ba med pas/ mngon spyod kyi las kyis tshar bcad nas bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig mdor na rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas/ ji srid yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du srung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i phrin las mdzod cig khyed kyis 'di rnams kyi khol po dang stong grogs gyis/ bar chad sel ba dang dgra bgegs thul la bsam don thams cad sgrubs shig ces bka' bsgos pas bka' bsgo zhal gyis bzhes te khyed rang gi phyi bzhin du 'brang bar mos pa mdzod/ rdo nag gi maṇ+ḍal steng nas me tog blangs la slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ mdun bskyed dang gtor ma'i steng du khyed rang gi mdun du bskyed pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te/ khyed rang mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas 'gal rkyen bar chad sel zhing mthun rkyen thams cad bsgrub par mos pa mdzod/

ces bka' bsgo'o// man ngag gi lung ta thā ga ta'i rgya gzhung dang*/ sgrub thabs mchan bshad klog pa brgyud pa'i phyag gzhes yin gsungs/ mchan/ sbyin pa ni 'di'i dpe rnams kyi lung rdzogs par sbyin pa'am yang na 'di'i rjes gnang gi dpe tsam gyi lung bya'o// rjes mi 'bral zhing gsang bar gdams pa la gnyis kyi/ dang po mi 'bral bar bya ba la gnyis las/ dang po sgrub pa po chos skyong dang mi 'bral ba'i ched du khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom tshul bzhin du byed pa dang*/ bye brag tu gsang sngags kyi chos zhus pa'i bla ma la gus par bya ba dang*/ khyad par rdo rje nag po chen po 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba dang gdams ngag zhus pa'i bla ma dang chos brgyud la dad cing gus par byas pas lus dang grib ma'i tshul du 'khor ba chos nyid yin pas de ltar bya dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa chos skyong sgrub pa po dang mi 'bral ba ni/ 'di'i rjes gnang legs par thob phyin chad rab kyis thun bzhi'am/ gsum mam/ gnyis sam/ tha mas kyang thun gcig la sogs pa la gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ de tsam ma grub na zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes brgyad gnyis dang*/ yar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang*/ mar ngo'i bcu bzhi sogs la gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ rang gis mi shes na gzhan 'bul du gzhug pa la brtson par bya dgos pa yin no// de ltar phul ba'i dgos pa ni/ rgyud las/ sems can rnams kyi srog bsrung phyir// rdo rje sems dpas gtor ma bstan// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gnyis pa gsang bar gdams pa ni/ rgya mtsho'i nang gi rdo ba bzhin// kha ru dbyung bar mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos thams cad gsang nas nyams su len dgos la/ khyad par rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang*/ gdams pa la sogs pa ston pa'i tshe/

dbang ma thob pa dang dam tshig dang mi ldan pa'i gang zag rnams la gsang dgos pa yin no// gsang ba'i chos mi 'dod pa la ston pa ni yan lag gi ltung bar bshad pa yin no// 'o na rtsa ba nas gsang ba yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ man ngag gser gyi yang zhun ni// snod ldan gcig la nub mi bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma re re tsam la ster na'ang bka' rgya dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bstan dgos pa yin no// zhes lha brgyad ltar bya'o// mdor na de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang*/ rjes gnang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar phul nas lus longs spyod la sogs pa slob dpon la drin lan du phul na cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas sogs brjod/ des rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i bka' bsrung thun mong ma yin pa dpal stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa'i rjes su gnang ba thun mong ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni yi ge brgya pa sogs gtor chog ltar bya'o// ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ga ga na shrī bha dras so// ༈ /'di'ang thar paṇa gyi gsung la sogs khongs bkrol te nag 'gros su phud pa dge legs 'phel/ ༈ /oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kaṭ+ṭa kā rā la/ laṃ bi ta o ṭha/ lam+bā ka be ka lam+ba ka bā le/ ra wi ghaṇ+ṭa/ ru dra mā la bi hu re/ ts+tsha da ha le/ ha le na ha le bim+bi dzā li/ bā me ghun+dhi dha raṃ yaṃ ma eṃ/ da hi na kartika kā ro ṭi/ bi bhi ṣa ṇa dha eṃ/ ba le shu la pā ṇi/ ha ra do ra/ na ra sī ra mā la/ bā tā le k+ṣiṃ kā ra kā la/ ma hā po ṭa le/ ma hā kā la/ shrī ka bi la/ ke la saṃ k+ṣe ṭa pā la/ hā hā kā re/

hūm̐ hūm̐ kā re/ purba bha ṣa bhi um̐/ dzau dzan+ti mām̐ sa bha ta/ phul+la dhū pa/ i kā hi ba li dzi gha ta/ da sha di ga ut+ta ra wu ri/ ḍom+bhi nī/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ rak+kha sī/ siṃ gha lī de wī/ ha na ha na/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ mā ra mā ra/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ/ le hi ba liṃ da hi sib+bhe/ bi kā la sha tru na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags ring yin no// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sngags thung yin lags/ 'khor lo'i sngags lnga ni/ sa i yam̐/ sa ka ra la yam̐/ sa hu bam̐/ ghṛ ta kī li kī lā ya/ bi bhi ṣa na ba ta na maḥ 'di la shan pa lnga'i sngags mang zer/ grong khyer dkrugs pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ u tsa ṭa tsa ṭe swā hā/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
